text:
This agitated, threatening demand for medication is acute stimulant withdrawal, so the dopamine state is decreased dopamine in the synaptic cleft (A). After cocaine or amphetamine use stops, stores are depleted and extracellular dopamine falls, producing irritability, agitation, and intense craving. Gradual dopamine-cell loss is a slower toxic effect and does not explain this acute ER picture.

CONFIDENCE: 72
